51124060.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity biotinylated human GST-tagged DCN1 by ITC method

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical) at 25 °C. The protein (biotinylated human GST-tagged DCN1) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 0.01% Triton X-100, pH 7.5, and concentrated to 100 μM. The compound was dissolved in DMSO and diluted in the same buffer to a final concentration of 1.5 mM. The protein was loaded into the sample cell (200 μL), and the compound was loaded into the syringe (250 μL). The titration consisted of 20 injections of 2 μL each, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The stirring speed was set to 300 rpm. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (MicroCal) with a one-site binding model. The binding affinity (Kd) was calculated from the fit of the data. The heat of dilution was determined by titrating the compound into buffer and subtracted from the raw data. The experiments were performed in triplicate.

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 0.01% Triton X-100
assay_conditions.control_method: Titration of compound into buffer and subtracted from raw data
